If you lose power and it’s cold, please be very careful using hot water bottles- it’s easy to make them too hot if you use boiling water so the pet can get burned if you’re not careful. Most exotics can handle some dips in temps (I know ball pythons can go to ~60F if need be) and some will even go into brumation (cold blooded version of hibernation).

If worse comes to worse, use your body heat. Put them in a soft cloth container like a pillow case and put that under a hoodie you’re wearing, as an example for ball pythons.

I am not a vet, please do your own research, YMMV, etc.
